title: documentation: add `Algolia requirements` to every widget documentation
body:
Some widgets are expecting to have the index configured in a certain way (attribute to index, attributes for faceting).

And some widgets are expecting some attributes to be in a certain type (boolean, hierarchical, slider..).

So we need to clearly indicates in a `#### Algolia requirements` what are the requirements
